points.description: States that backpropagation reduces/minimises the error (loss) of a multilayer perceptron / neural network by propagating the error backwards recursively, from the last (output) layer to the first layer, layer by layer, by updating the weights. Equivalent wording accepted.
States that the weight updates are determined by the local gradient at each layer, computed using partial derivatives of the error and the chain rule.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if only gradients/derivatives of the error are mentioned without the chain rule (or the chain rule without gradients/partial derivatives).
